reason: I only commute two days a week and I already have my spot that knows my order and gets me out in two minutes. A brand-new place tucked inside another bar with no reviews isn't worth risking a slow line and an $8 dessert latte before my train.
objection: No reviews yet. I don't know if the regular flat white is actually good or if it's mostly a photo-op drink place, and I don't know how fast they are at 8am.
would_change_my_mind: Solid reviews saying the plain flat white is excellent and service is fast, or a coworker vouching for it, and I'd try it once on an office day.
